content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for BBMB Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: 25% seats out of total available seats for each trade will be given to candidates possessing residency certificate of concerned districts Candidates who have undergone or undergoing apprenticeship training in any other establishment are not eligible

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for BBMB Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates whose results are still awaited on the last date of receipt of applications Candidates already registered and got training under apprenticeship schemes

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Stipend as per Apprenticeship Act; amount not printed in the notice. One-year apprenticeship training for session 2026-27 Contracts of selected candidates registered on the NAPS portal Engagement subject to Apprenticeship Act 1961 and its amendments

content_sections.heading: How Will BBMB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection based on merit list prepared for all applicants from NAPS/NATS database Merit list prepared on the basis of percentage of marks in matriculation 10th and ITI course or graduation/diploma Merit list prepared from NAPS/NATS database

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: 10th Mark sheet ITI Certificate & Marksheets Category certificate Residence/Domicile certificate Aadhaar Card

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBMB Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online on www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in (NAPS) portal for ITI trades. Apply online on nats.education.gov.in (NATS) portal for graduate/diploma holders. Apply on or before 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Number of vacancies may be increased or decreased.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BBMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026. Applications opened on 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BBMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 58 vacancies: 3 Mechanical / Electrical / Civil Engineering (Degree Holder), 2 BA, 2 B.Com, 2 B.Sc, 3 Mechanical / Electrical / Civil Engineering (Diploma Holder), 8 Fitter and 8 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for BBMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per Apprentice Act 1961.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: BA, B.Com, B.Sc, Diploma, ITI, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. 25% seats out of total available seats for each trade will be given to candidates possessing residency certificate of concerned districts. Candidates who have undergone or undergoing apprenticeship training in any other establishment are not eligible.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates whose results are still awaited on the last date of receipt of applications. Candidates already registered and got training under apprenticeship schemes.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection based on merit list prepared for all applicants from NAPS/NATS database. Merit list prepared on the basis of percentage of marks in matriculation 10th and ITI course or graduation/diploma. Merit list prepared from NAPS/NATS database.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: One-year apprenticeship training for session 2026-27. Contracts of selected candidates registered on the NAPS portal. Engagement subject to Apprenticeship Act 1961 and its amendments.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Nangal.
